about: Owner annotation marks on the entrance photos, decoded into the local metre frame. Written by the entrance-decode task (scratch scripts in out/entrance-decode/). See docs/plan/entrance_annotations.md.

colourKey.yellow: buildings of the same architecture with prayer wheels; the yellow building at the very opening is the gate (owner)
colourKey.green/mint (\"light cyan green\"): sharp edges, walls and raised objects

conventions: points/center in local metres (x east, z south, origin 27.8050 N 86.7100 E); centerWorld = center * 0.65 (game world); size in real metres [long, short]; yawDeg = compass bearing of the long axis (or of the passage for the gate), clockwise from north; in three.js rotation.y = -yawDeg * PI / 180. colour is the owner's stroke colour. Lines are ordered top of image to bottom (water: upstream to downstream).

transform.from: reference/chat/chat_05.webp pixels (u right, v down; 887 x 735). chat_06 is the same Google Earth view panned: u05 = u06 - 354, v05 = v06 - 3.
transform.to: local metres, x east, z south, origin 27.8050 N 86.7100 E (mlat 110816 m/deg, mlon 98541 m/deg), the frame of docs/audit/landmarks.json
transform.worldFromLocal: world = local * 0.65 about the origin (layout.json scale); human-scale sizes are not scaled
transform.notes: The 9 control points pair the owner's own marks with the OSM features they plainly denote. Independent check: all OSM buildings, paths and water pushed through the fit onto chat_06 (out/entrance-decode/ov06_crop.png) land on their roofs to about 1 to 3 m (roofs west of the stupa, the L-shaped cafe roof, the gate roof, the pavilion roofs over the channel). Google Earth is a slightly oblique 3D view and the strokes are about 1 m wide, so read every converted mark as +/- 3 m. A homography was unstable and is not used.

features.notes: Kani gate. Owner: "the very opening a yellow similar architecture building gate". The outline is loose (15 x 9 m round a 4.5 m building); its centre falls 0.5 m from the OSM footprint. Use OSM way/344630686 centre (-24.7, 191.1) and the measured body: 4.5 m square, walls 2.6 m, passage 2.1 m wide x 2.2 m high running north-south at x -24.3, eave band 0.65 m with 16-18 roundels, ridge 3.8-4.0 m, gold finial top 4.5 m. yawDeg here is the passage axis (front faces south, bearing 180). Model: gate3.glb.
features.source: reference/chat/chat_05.webp yellow pentagon round the small red roof at the bottom of the trail; chat_10 yellow outline px [310,32,965,579] with finial and passage; chat_09 unmarked; reference/measure/gate_scale.png

features.notes: OSM way/1050011453, amenity=cafe "Stupa cafe" (use an invented name in game). The owner outlined it in yellow, but his key gives yellow to prayer-wheel buildings and the gate; the photos show a modern restaurant with a red tile roof, fairy lights and a terrace. Read as "same roof style" until he says otherwise (question for the owner). Keep the OSM L footprint; its terrace fills the notch of the L facing the steps.
features.source: reference/chat/chat_05.webp yellow L-shaped outline round the L red roof; it is the lit restaurant in chat_09, chat_10 (left, mint terrace lines) and chat_12 (left)
features.yawNote: yawDeg is taken from the OSM footprint (side bearing, 0-90); markYawDeg is the long axis of the hand-drawn outline and carries little information.

features.notes: Main stupa, OSM way/344630942 (man_made=stupa). Scribble centre 1.4 m from OSM; its 14 m size is the scribble, not the stupa. Use the measured shape: stepped square white plinth about 11 m, white dome about 0.6 x base, gold harmika with eyes, gold 13-ring spire with a green skirt; total height about 0.95 x base (10 to 11 m). Model: stupa2.glb (spire about 20 % too tall).
features.source: reference/chat/chat_05.webp white scribble; chat_10 white outline px [16,13,224,291]; chat_12 white outline px [221,151,401,350]; reference/measure/stupa_tops.png

features.notes: Stream from the head pool down the pavilion row to the fountain. Agrees with OSM way/1267933025..34 to 2 to 3 m; the line runs through every row pavilion, matching the OSM culverts under each one. Flow is south-west (downhill, from the top point to the bottom point).
features.source: reference/chat/chat_05.webp blue line down the pavilion column (visible between the yellow boxes); chat_12 blue right px [734,376,1112,534] running along the top of the right retaining wall from the first row pavilion down to the right bridge rail

features.notes: The dot sits on the Google label pin, which lands 8.7 m north-east of the OSM fountain pool way/1267933037 (-23.3, 170.1, 5.5 m across) and node/11775705677. Google pins are label anchors, not surveyed; keep the OSM pool. In plaza_grid the fountain is a tall jet in a basin right of the steps, behind the curved bridge rail.
features.source: reference/chat/chat_05.webp filled blue dot painted over the Google "Namche Bazar Fountain" pin

features.notes: Stream after it passes under the steps just inside the gate, running south-west between the cafe and the gate and on down the ravine. Agrees with OSM culvert way/1267933035 and stream way/312775993 to about 3 m. It never crosses the trail below the gate.
features.source: reference/chat/chat_05.webp blue line from the bridge south-west past the cafe; chat_12 blue left px [102,550,417,578] under the left (west) bridge rails

features.notes: Sharp edge along the main stone steps way/551442828: it lies on the OSM centreline to about 1 m, between the 2 m stepped path (west) and the stream and pavilion terraces (east). Build as the kerb or low wall on the east side of the steps. High side: east (pavilion terraces) near the bottom, from chat_12 and chat_19; not certain higher up.
features.source: reference/chat/chat_05.webp green line along the west side of the pavilion column; chat_19 (unmarked) shows the kerb between the steps and the pavilion terraces

features.notes: Raised paved platform (plaza) holding the stupa and the side pavilion; edge on all sides, high side inside. Converted loop is 33 x 18 m on a long axis of bearing 129 deg, including the eastern lobe round the side pavilion, which reaches the foot of the main steps at about (-27, 170). M1 has a 19 x 16 m plaza centred on the stupa only.
features.source: reference/chat/chat_05.webp green closed loop round the stupa and the side pavilion; chat_03 shows the stupa on a raised paved platform above the open ground

features.notes: Stone retaining wall on the east (right) side of the trail for about 20 m below the gate. On the OSM trail way/551441452 centreline to about 1 m, so build it at the trail's east edge. High side: east (bank above the wall), from chat_09 and chat_10.
features.source: reference/chat/chat_05.webp green line up the trail to the gate's south-east corner; chat_10 mint right px [812,218,966,652]; chat_09 stone wall with a sack on top right of the gate

features.notes: The real crossing: the steps from the gate pass over the stream here (OSM way/1373254109 over culvert way/1267933035; no bridge tag). The stroke is the east parapet, a curved maroon railing 0.8 to 0.9 m high with the white key pattern, about 10 m along, bowed about 0.5 m. Landmarks footbridge_plaza (-28.8, 178.4) lies 4 m west of the stroke centre: that is the deck centreline; the parapets stand either side of a 4 to 5 m wide stair. Not in OSM: register as invented, reason "owner annotation chat_05 and photos chat_11/chat_12". Model: bridge2.glb (1.6 m wide; real about 2 m, here wider still).
features.source: reference/chat/chat_05.webp red curved stroke between the gate and the fountain, across a gap in the blue line; chat_12 red right rail px [616,471,808,559] (bearings and the 0.85 m rail height put it 9 m from the camera, matching this mark); plaza_grid foreground rail; chat_10 red px [487,321,545,361] seen through the passage

features.notes: Second red mark, on the east edge of the main steps for 11 m beside row pavilion 1 (on the OSM steps line to about 1 m). It runs along the channel, not across it, so it is a railed edge or a footbridge from the steps onto the pavilion-1 terrace over the channel; most likely the "second footbridge further up the channel" seen in the owner's photos. Not in OSM: register as invented, reason "owner annotation chat_05". Not visible in chat_10 or chat_12. Question for the owner.
features.source: reference/chat/chat_05.webp red stroke continuing the green steps edge, beside row pavilion 1

features.notes: West parapet of the same crossing as bridge_gate_inner: the curved maroon rail with the white key pattern on the left of the steps in chat_12, continuing as the long low rail along the downstream channel at the left of the frame (px [2,474,507,627]). The top view draws only the east parapet. Position is bridge_gate_inner moved about 3.5 m west (stair width 4 to 5 m); good to about 3 m. Not in OSM: invented, reason "owner annotation chat_12".
features.source: reference/chat/chat_12.webp red left px [2,474,507,627]; chat_11 unmarked; chat_10 red px [487,321,545,361] through the passage

features.notes: Tall dressed-stone retaining wall on the right (east) of the steps from the gate's north-east corner up towards row pavilion 1; the stream runs along its top (blue right in chat_12) and the fountain basin stands at its foot. About 2 to 3 m high at the gate, lower up-slope. Course estimated from chat_11/12 bearings and the OSM fountain and stream; good to about 3 m. Not in OSM: invented, reason "owner annotation chat_12".
features.source: reference/chat/chat_12.webp mint px [805,381,1046,511], [941,400,1189,464], [985,368,1189,427], [810,520,925,644]; chat_10 mint right px [812,218,966,652] (outside the gate the same wall line continues as edge_trail_east_wall)

features.notes: Front edge of the cafe's raised terrace (railing, chairs, fairy lights), facing east to the steps across the notch of the OSM L footprint. Terrace floor about 1.5 to 2.5 m above the gate apron (chat_09/10). Ticks under the line in chat_10 are the railing posts. Not in OSM: invented, reason "owner annotation chat_10/chat_12".
features.source: reference/chat/chat_10.webp mint left px [0,178,315,327]; chat_12 mint left px [66,311,370,535] (the vertical stroke at px x 358 is the terrace corner)

features.notes: The first flight just past the gate's north face: about 6 risers (about 1 m in all) up to a landing between the two bridge parapets, 4 to 5 m wide. Lines on the treads in chat_12 and through the passage in chat_10. Follows OSM way/1373254109; M1 already builds six risers here.

Front edge of the stone apron outside the gate on its west side, where it drops to the yard with the stone water-spout trough and the blue bench (chat_09/10, not marked in the top view). Position estimated from chat_10 to about 3 m. Not in OSM: invented, reason "owner annotation chat_10".
features.source: reference/chat/chat_10.webp mint bottom px [69,593,452,655]

The owner outlined it yellow. Not in the top view and not in OSM; position from bearings only, good to about 5 m. Invented, reason "owner annotation chat_12".
